body:
Maxwell the Cat Totem

Bring the internet's favorite spinning feline into your Minecraft world! This lighthearted resource pack completely transforms the standard, boring Totem of Undying into a detailed, custom-textured model of **Maxwell the Cat** (also known as Uni). 

Now, instead of a tiny golden statue, you will carry the iconic black-and-white cat in your off-hand to protect you from unexpected falls, lava dips, and unexpected creeper blasts. 

## Features
* **Custom Totem Texture:** Replaces the vanilla Totem of Undying icon and in-hand model with a crisp, high-quality sprite of Maxwell the Cat.
* **Immersive Saving Grace:** Watch Maxwell pop up on your screen to grant you Fire Resistance, Regeneration, and Absorption whenever your health drops to zero.
* **Lightweight Performance:** Optimized resolution ensures zero frame drops, making it perfectly compatible with low-end PCs and massive modpacks.

## Installation Guide
1. Download the `.zip` file for your matching Minecraft version.
2. Open Minecraft and navigate to **Options** > **Resource Packs** > **Open Pack Folder**.
3. Drag and drop the downloaded `.zip` file into the folder.
4. Select the pack from the "Available" list in-game and move it to the "Selected" column.
5. Click **Done** and enjoy your new feline protector!

## Compatibility
This resource pack is **100% vanilla-compatible** and does not require OptiFine, Fabric API, or any configuration mods to work. Simply load it up on any version and start playing. It can safely be placed at the top of your resource pack list to overwrite any other custom totem textures you might have installed.
